label: ZXA10 C320 OLT
description: ZTE ZXA10 C320 compact OLT, 2U 19-inch chassis with 2 service-card slots and 2 main-control switching slots (SMXA, GPON/P2P/XG-PON1). This spec models one GTGH 16-port GPON card in service slot 2 (gpon2/1-16) + 2x 10GE SFP+ uplinks (one per SMXA when both control cards are fitted) + 1 out-of-band management FE port = 19 ports.
